model_comparison.status: diagnostic; scenario differences do not imply failed integrity or feasibility

capacity_factor_tech.notes:
legacy_charging_profiles: Frozen Ontario RAMP-mobility charging simulations using 2018 weather and embedded fleet, range and charger composition; normalized load shapes, not measured charger utilization.
  - nhts: Ontario charging simulation with NHTS 2022 travel inputs and 2018 weather; inherited BEV fleet and charger mix also proxy other regions and shared LDV charging.

cost_invest.notes:
cer_canadas_energy_future: Canadian energy and macroeconomic projections conditional on the selected report edition and policy scenario.
  - macro-indicators: Canada-level real GDP, deflator and exchange-rate series; macroeconomic paths provide provincial transport-demand growth proxies and currency-conversion inputs.
faa_economic_values: U.S. air-carrier capacity, utilization and maintenance evidence for the year ending June 2023, aggregated separately for passenger and freight aircraft.
  - section_3_capacity: Passenger and freight All Aircraft capacity, load, speed and utilization averages used to normalize aircraft costs to transport service.
emrg_sfu_cims_model: Canadian model assumptions for representative aircraft, rail and marine service units, capital costs and process lifetimes.
  - transport_service_output_and_capex: Representative aircraft, rail and marine capital costs in 2015 CAD, with rail/marine service output per unit; these are model assumptions rather than fleet transaction averages.

cost_fixed.notes:
cer_canadas_energy_future: Canadian energy and macroeconomic projections conditional on the selected report edition and policy scenario.
  - macro-indicators: Canada-level real GDP, deflator and exchange-rate series; macroeconomic paths provide provincial transport-demand growth proxies and currency-conversion inputs.
open_energy_outlook: U.S. model assumptions for rail/marine operating-cost ratios and charging-infrastructure fixed costs and lifetime.
  - charger_fixed_cost_ratio: Annual charger fixed operating cost assumed proportional to investment cost; the reviewed ratio is common to charger classes.
dunsky_ev_charging_infrastructure: Canadian LD/MHD charging projections with reviewed port mixes, utilization and equipment/installation costs; cost inputs retain 2022 CAD per rated charging power.
nlr_alternative_fueling_infrastructure: U.S. residential L1 port cost estimate, represented by the reviewed cost midpoint and normalized to rated charging power in 2021 USD.

  - section_4_operating_costs: Passenger and freight All Aircraft maintenance expense per block hour in reviewed 2023 USD; underlying carrier data end in June 2023.

demand.notes:
nrcan_ceud_transport_provincial: Provincial transport energy, activity and fleet statistics by vehicle class; aggregate series do not identify individual vehicle vintages or technologies.
  - 20: Provincial passenger-car service activity in passenger-kilometres.
cer_canadas_energy_future: Canadian energy and macroeconomic projections conditional on the selected report edition and policy scenario.
  - macro-indicators: Canada-level real GDP, deflator and exchange-rate series; macroeconomic paths provide provincial transport-demand growth proxies and currency-conversion inputs.

efficiency.notes: nrcan_ceud_transport_national: Canadian air, rail and marine activity and energy intensities; national averages provide intensity proxies for provincial service activity.

existing_capacity.notes:
nrcan_ceud_transport_provincial: Provincial transport energy, activity and fleet statistics by vehicle class; aggregate series do not identify individual vehicle vintages or technologies.
  - 21: Provincial car stock, sales and distance travelled; fleet totals require separate age and fuel evidence for technology cohorts.
ontario_ministry_transport_vehicle_population: Ontario vehicle registrations by status, model year and vehicle class; registration-status changes are not direct observations of physical retirement.
  - A: Fit-active Ontario make/model cohorts classified through reviewed mappings; suppressed and unresolved keys limit represented fleet coverage.
statcan_transport_tables: Canadian vehicle registrations, freight flows and reported transit-asset useful lives; coverage and statistical concepts differ by table.
  - 20-10-0021-01: Archived annual new-LDV registrations by province, vehicle type and fuel; supplies history before current-table coverage, not the age distribution of surviving stock.
nrcan_fuel_consumption_ratings: Canadian vehicle-model test ratings and electric ranges; fleet aggregation and historical indexing are applied separately, and rated consumption does not measure in-use fleet performance.
  - plug_in_hybrid_2012_2026: Canadian PHEV ratings with charge-sustaining fuel consumption, electric range and charge-depleting rating fields; their distinct energy and operating-mode meanings are retained.
nhtsa_cafe_ldv_survival: U.S. CAFE cumulative vehicle-survival schedules by age and broad vehicle class; used as Canadian lifetime proxies across powertrains.
fueleconomy_gov_vehicle_data: U.S. model-year make/model and vehicle-class records used to corroborate Canadian vehicle classification; model names and classes require harmonization.

lifetime_tech.notes: argonne_hdsam: Gaseous-hydrogen refueling dispenser lifetime from HDSAM v4.5 economic assumptions, applied to the hydrogen-refueling technology category.

lifetime_survival_curve.notes: epa_moves_heavy_truck_survival: Conditional annual survival for a pooled U.S. heavy-duty class, based on model-year-1980 evidence extended to age 40; a proxy for current Canadian trucks.

limit_annual_capacity_factor.notes:
nrcan_ceud_transport_provincial: Provincial transport energy, activity and fleet statistics by vehicle class; aggregate series do not identify individual vehicle vintages or technologies.
  - 20: Provincial passenger-car service activity in passenger-kilometres.
  - 21: Provincial car stock, sales and distance travelled; fleet totals require separate age and fuel evidence for technology cohorts.

limit_tech_input_split.notes:
statcan_transport_tables: Canadian vehicle registrations, freight flows and reported transit-asset useful lives; coverage and statistical concepts differ by table.
  - 23-10-0142-01: For-hire truck freight shipments and tonne-kilometres by origin and destination; haul shares proxy the broader heavy-truck fleet.
nlr_atb_transportation: U.S. road-vehicle technology trajectories and operating assumptions by class and powertrain; Canadian fleet weighting and service conversion are applied separately.
  - phev_utility_factor_mdhd: MHDV share of travel in charge-depleting operation by vehicle class, based on Autonomie range and simulated usage.
  - phev_vehicle_inputs: Autonomie PHEV charge-sustaining fuel use, charge-depleting electricity use and drive-cycle contributions; combined consumption requires the corresponding fleet utility factors.
argonne_rd_greet: Fuel-property and process-model evidence from R&D GREET; the registered components distinguish heating values, marine intensity and vehicle-cycle results.
  - fuel_heating_values: Gasoline and diesel higher heating values from registered GREET fuel-property cells; source units are Btu per U.S. gallon.

limit_new_capacity_share.notes:
epa_omega_baseline: U.S. OMEGA MY2022 baseline sales and on-road charge-depleting ranges; car/light-truck range shares proxy Canadian plug-in fleets and remain fixed across modeled vintages.
  - baseline_sales_ranges.range_share_floor: Range shares constrain new within-class/powertrain capacity; they do not specify adoption or historical stock.

emission_embodied.notes:
statcan_transport_tables: Canadian vehicle registrations, freight flows and reported transit-asset useful lives; coverage and statistical concepts differ by table.
  - 23-10-0142-01: For-hire truck freight shipments and tonne-kilometres by origin and destination; haul shares proxy the broader heavy-truck fleet.
argonne_rd_greet: Fuel-property and process-model evidence from R&D GREET; the registered components distinguish heating values, marine intensity and vehicle-cycle results.
  - road_vehicle_cycle_emissions: Saved 2025 GREET vehicle-cycle lifetime gas totals, with LDV cohort 2020; includes materials, assembly and end of life without recycling credits. Material and range cases remain separate.
